Columns are tool identifiers (see [Tools](tools/)). Rows are measures, grouped by family, subfamily and concept; the concept name links to its page and each variant links to its section. Every symbol is a link: hover for the reason, or follow it to the full reason on the measure's page (for a state other than checked, agrees) or to the definition of the state on [How entries are labelled](method.html) (for checked, agrees). Entries marked with a reason the sources only partly give say so in the detail.
